title: RL Post-Training Qwen3.5-4B to Write Animated Isometric SVG Scenes
description: RL with LoRA on Qwen3.5-4B using rule-based checks, sandboxed rendering, frame checks and a VLM judge. More answers passed the rule-based checks and showed motion; isometric drawing remained rare.
excerpt: Evaluation reward rose on test and the held-out space category. On test, the rates for valid SVG and animation reached 97% and 91%; scene recognition, object visibility and composition judgments also improved. Isometric drawing remained rare.
thumbnailAlt: Side-by-side animated scenes compare base answers on the left with RL answers on the right for matching prompts and seeds
thumbnailCaption: Figure 1. Selected final-evaluation examples. Base answers appear on the left, RL answers on the right; each comparison uses an identical prompt and generation seed. Figure 5 shows a random sample later in the post.
